chinese: 许多人认为要想成功你必须长时间工作
english: Many people believe that to be successful you have to work long hours
soundmark: /ˈmeni ˈpiːpəl bɪˈliːv ðæt tuː biː səkˈsesfəl juː hæv tuː wɜːrk lɒŋ ˈaʊərz/

chinese: 但最近的研究表明并非如此
生产力的关键是知道何时停下来休息
english: The key to productivity is knowing when to stop and rest
soundmark: /ðə kiː tuː ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti ɪz ˈnoʊɪŋ wen tuː stɒp ænd rest/

chinese: 定期休息的人更加专注犯更少的错误
english: Those who take regular breaks are more focused and make fewer mistakes
soundmark: /ðoʊz huː teɪk ˈreɡjələr breɪks ɑːr mɔːr ˈfoʊkəst ænd meɪk ˈfjuːər mɪˈsteɪks/

chinese: 从长远来看平衡比持续努力更重要
english: In the long run balance is more important than constant effort
soundmark: /ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn ˈbæləns ɪz mɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ðæn ˈkɒnstənt ˈefərt/

chinese: 他们优先处理重要任务避免做无用功
english: They prioritize important tasks and avoid busywork
soundmark: /ðeɪ praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tɑːsks ænd əˈvɔɪd ˈbɪziwɜːrk/

chinese: 学会休息和学会工作一样重要
english: Learning to rest is just as important as learning to work
soundmark: /ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tuː rest ɪz dʒʌst æz ɪmˈpɔːrtənt æz ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tuː wɜːrk/
